stem: Zane wants to provide more detail in sentence 23. Which of the following could replace sentence 23 and best accomplish this goal?

options.label: A
options.text: Could this be a way to provide and give better medical care to people who may really need it today?

options.label: B
options.text: Could this be a method for providing better and improved medical care to people who live in places outside the United States?

options.label: C
options.text: Could this be a way to provide better medical care to people in rural communities, war zones, or isolated parts of the world?

options.label: D
options.text: Could this be a way for excited and engaged doctors to provide enriched medical care to people and patients whom they care so much about?
